description:
As a global film star with almost 90 million Instagram followers, National Geographic 33 changemaker Alia Bhatt is using her massive reach to highlight the importance of environmental film projects and inspire others to take action. She is also authoring a series of children’s books for the next generation. Learn more about where it all started: https://go.natgeo.blink.app/967835

The National Geographic 33—inspired by our 33 founders—is an initiative honoring changemakers who are rising to meet the most critical challenges of our time, making meaningful progress and incredible breakthroughs.
